rationale: B separates verse construction into a _verse helper, so recite only joins verses. It keys comments by animal name instead of a 1-based verse number, which is more self-describing and less fragile. The names predator and prey make the chain line easy to read. A puts all the logic inline in recite and indexes COMMENTS by verse number. It also uses the magic number 8 where B states 'not the horse' explicitly. Both are correct and concise, but B's structure and naming are cleaner.
